reason: Clarify that floating rates need an all-in cap.

proposed_change.old_text: A fixed interest rate for the duration of the loan, or a floating rate (EURIBOR/SOFR) with a clear, enforceable cap to prevent rising costs.
proposed_change.new_text: A fixed rate is preferred; any floating EURIBOR/SOFR-based rate must include a hard all-in cap and transparent margin so total interest remains forecastable.
